To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
A systematic approach for assessing the manufacturing capabilities of laser micro machining systems is proposed and validated.

a systematic and comprehensive approach is presented to characterize and improve the system level performance and thus the manufacturing capabilities of reconfigurable laser micro manufacturing platforms.

the proposed generic system level tools and methodologies can be used in the development and integration of LMM platforms for improving their performance in terms of manufacturing capabilities and reliability in different processing configurations and thus to enable the broader industrial uptake and exploitation of this promising technology.
In summary, our research is concerned with
developing the necessary system level capabilities for improving the ARR of LMM systems both in stand alone configurations and also as hybrid manufacturing platforms.
developing the generic system level tools and methodologies for implementing modular LMM platforms.
the development of generic system integration tools for improving and optimizing the system level performance and thus the ARR in reconfigurable LLM platforms.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the research reported in the thesis has resulted in the development of novel and generic system level tools which can significantly improve the system level performance and the capabilities of reconfigurable laser micro manufacturing platforms and thus create the necessary pre-requisites for achieving a broader industrial uptake of the technology in different manufacturing sectors.

the research presented in this thesis has provided new and novel generic tools and methodologies for improving the system performance of LMM systems and thus to enable the development of flexible and reliable reconfigurable LMS platforms for realizing high precision and high quality micro parts in various processing configurations.

the research reported in the present thesis has successfully demonstrated the feasibility of developing reconfigurable LLM systems with improved manufacturing capabilities and system level performance.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the research presented in this thesis is the first step towards developing generic tools and methods that could be used to implement modular LMM platforms with enhanced system level capabilities.
the research reported in the thesis has created the necessary pre requisities for the design and implementation of reconfigurable and modular LMM systems.

the research presented in this thesis has resulted in the development of generic system integration tools for improving both the manufacturing capabilities and the system level performance (flexibility and reliability) of reconfigurable laser micro machining platforms.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the system level performance in LMM can be improved by developing generic integration tools for implementing reconfigurable laser micro manufacturing platforms.

the system level performance and thus the manufacturing capabilities of reconfigurable laser micro machining platforms can be improved by implementing a set of generic tools for improving the integration and interoperability between the different system level elements, i.e. the laser source, the processing head, the motion control, the machine tool structure, the manufacturing process, the process control, the machine vision and the data acquisition.

the proposed generic system level integration tools are able to improve the manufacturing capabilities of reconfigurable laser processing platforms and thus to increase their industrial uptake in different applications.
